from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

def embed(smi):
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
    p = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed = 42
    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, p)==0
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
    return m

def face_signs(m, ring_atoms, subs):
    # ring plane from 3 ring atoms; sign of substituent atom positions
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    pts = [np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in ring_atoms]
    n = np.cross(pts[1]-pts[0], pts[2]-pts[0]); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
    c = sum(pts)/3
    return [float(np.dot(np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(s))-c, n)) for s in subs]

for tag in ["[C@H]1C[C@H]1", "[C@H]1C[C@@H]1"]:
    m = embed(f"CC{tag}CC")
    # find ring atoms
    ring = m.GetSubstructMatch(Chem.MolFromSmarts("[C]1CC1"))
    # heavy atom ring indices
    ringh = [i for i in ring]
    # substituents: neighbors of ring atoms not in ring (heavy)
    subs=[]
    for i in ringh:
        for nb in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
            if nb.GetIdx() not in ringh and nb.GetSymbol()!='H':
                subs.append(nb.GetIdx())
    print(tag, "ring", ringh, "subs", subs, "signs", np.round(face_signs(m, ringh, subs),2),
          "=> trans" if np.prod(face_signs(m, ringh, subs))<0 else "=> cis")

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

def build(tags):
    # tags: list of 6 tuples (entry_tag, exit_tag)
    rings = "".join(f"[C{t1}H]{i}C[C{t2}H]{i}" for i,(t1,t2) in enumerate(tags,1))
    smi = f"CC(C)CNC(=O)/C=C/{rings}/C=C/[C{t1}H]6C[C{t2}H]6C"
    # careful: last ring uses tags[5]
    rings5 = "".join(f"[C{a}H]{i}C[C{b}H]{i}" for i,(a,b) in enumerate(tags[:5],1))
    a6,b6 = tags[5]
    smi = f"CC(C)CNC(=O)/C=C/{rings5}/C=C/[C{a6}H]6C[C{b6}H]6C"
    return Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)

backbone = [5,7,8,9,11,12,14,15,17,18,20,21,23,24,25,26,28,29]
ch2s = [10,13,16,19,22,27]
ring_pairs = [(9,11),(12,14),(15,17),(18,20),(21,23),(26,28)]

def analyze(m):
    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
    p = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    best=None
    for seed in range(8):
        p.randomSeed = seed*7+1
        mm = Chem.Mol(m)
        if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mm,p)!=0: continue
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mm)
        conf=mm.GetConformer()
        pos = np.array([conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in range(mm.GetNumAtoms())])
        d = np.linalg.norm(pos[29]-pos[5])
        if best is None or d>best[0]: best=(d,mm)
    mm = best[1]; conf=mm.GetConformer()
    pos = np.array([conf.GetAtomPosition(i) for i in range(mm.GetNumAtoms())])
    # plane through backbone
    bp = pos[backbone]; c = bp.mean(0)
    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(bp-c)
    n = vt[2]
    signs = [np.dot(pos[i]-c,n) for i in ch2s]
    # trans check per ring: substituent (prev,next backbone atom) on opp faces of ring plane
    transok=[]
    for k,(a,b) in enumerate(ring_pairs):
        mid = [i for i in ch2s][k]
        rpts=[pos[a],pos[b],pos[mid]]; rn=np.cross(rpts[1]-rpts[0],rpts[2]-rpts[0]); rn/=np.linalg.norm(rn)
        # substituent atoms on a and b (heavy, not in ring)
        def sub(x):
            return [nb.GetIdx() for nb in mm.GetAtomWithIdx(x).GetNeighbors() if nb.GetIdx() not in (a,b,mid) and nb.GetSymbol()!='H'][0]
        sa, sb = sub(a), sub(b)
        rc = sum(rpts)/3
        transok.append(np.sign(np.dot(pos[sa]-rc,rn)*np.dot(pos[sb]-rc,rn))<0)
    return best[0], np.round(signs,2), transok

patterns = {
 "A all @/@@": [("@","@@")]*6,
 "B all @@/@": [("@@","@")]*6,
 "C alt": [("@","@@"),("@@","@")]*3,
 "D alt2": [("@@","@"),("@","@@")]*3,
}
for name,tags in patterns.items():
    m = build(tags)
    d, signs, transok = analyze(m)
    print(name, "end2end=%.1f"%d, "CH2 signs:", signs, "trans:", transok)
